title: Kirkpatrick's AARO denied the Herrera incident but he privately admitted it to the Senate Intelligence Committee
summary: Jake Barber tells of Kirkpatrick's AARO denied the Herrera incident but he privately admitted it to the Senate Intelligence Committee, about 2023-2024 at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And I know for a fact that Sean Kapatrick has admitted outside of the office of arrow directly to members of the Senate Intelligence Committee that it did in fact happen exactly as reported by Michael Herrera and with my additions.

plain: A man named Jake Barber, who says he once flew a helicopter to retrieve a UFO, says that Sean Kirkpatrick, the head of AARO (a Pentagon office set up to look into unexplained flying objects), publicly denied an incident described by a witness named Michael Herrera. But Barber says he knows for a fact that Kirkpatrick privately told members of the Senate Intelligence Committee, the group of US senators who oversee spy agencies, that it happened exactly as Herrera reported, plus what Barber himself added. If true, the official denial and the private admission would contradict each other.
